goals.notes: I like the AI/compute theme long term. Keep me honest on risk - I over-concentrated in miners once already.

thesis: Your $500/month alone gets you to $30,143 by mid-2029, so the job is capturing AI/compute upside without another miner-sized hole — rotate SGOV's 35.8% into quality semis and infrastructure on weakness, with hard caps on speculative names.
short_term: Trim SGOV from 35.8% to ~15% over four weeks, selling ~$850/week and deploying only on red days like today's -2.44%.
Cap IREN plus CIFR at 10% combined (~$1,200); sell CIFR above $20 into any bounce, matching your earlier $19.75 exit.
Hold IREN at RSI 30.6 but do not average down at -36.6%; exit entirely on a close below this week's low.
Add to NVDA near $191 per your pinned rule while the 200-day holds, building it from $590 toward $1,000.
Buy the AAPL breakout alert: add ~$300 above today's high with RSI 60.3 confirming, stop at the breakout level.
Skip PANW at RSI 78.5; set a limit to start CRWD (64/100 score) on a pullback toward $185, quarter-size only.
long_term: Build NVDA, AMD, TSM, and AVGO into a 45-50% core via the $500/month, buying whichever sits lowest versus its 50-day.
Grow TSM from its $47 stub to $1,500+ over two years; it is the fabrication bottleneck for every AI name you own.
Add an Energy sleeve starting with NEE near $88 (RSI 53.9), targeting 8%, because power supply is the binding constraint on data-center growth.
Give MSFT (down 10.8%, downtrend) two quarters to reclaim its long-term trend; otherwise rotate those dollars into the semi core.
Let Compute Power miners shrink to under 7% by never adding; your edge is picks-and-shovels, not leveraged bitcoin-adjacent operators.
Reinvest all SGOV interest and keep contributions automatic; the math needs roughly 0% return, so every point of gain is buffer.
guardrails: No single stock above 12% of portfolio (~$1,450 today); trim back within one week of breaching.
Miners capped at 10% combined and never averaged down; a -35% loss like IREN's current -36.6% forces a written keep-or-kill decision.
If portfolio drawdown from high exceeds 15% (max was -22.2%), pause all buys and rebuild Cash & Income to 25%.
Never open or add to any position with RSI above 75; PANW at 78.5 fails this test today.
Portfolio beta stays under 1.5 (now 1.44); fund any new high-beta buy by trimming an existing high-beta name.
milestones: By October 2026: portfolio at ~$14,000 with SGOV under 20% and miners under 10%, proving the rotation executed.
By January 2027: all-time P/L back to breakeven from today's -8.4%, driven by the semi core, not miner recoveries.
By July 2027: ~$19,500-$20,500 with the four-name semi core at 40%+ and Sharpe still above 1.0.
By July 2028: ~$25,500 with Energy sleeve at 8% and no position ever having breached the 12% cap.
By July 2029: $30,000+ reached with max drawdown along the way held inside -20%.
